review_candidates.title: Desenvolvedor full stack Sênior | Foco em IA
review_candidates.description: Objetivo em comum: Conquistar alto nível de satisfação dos Clientes e o atendimento dos resultados planejados Missão do Cargo: Analisar, planejar e executar desenvolvimento e/ou manutenção de soluções de GIS/TI nas fases de Design, Construção, Tecnologia, Requisitos, Teste, Infraestrutura, Configuração e Qualidade. Atividades: Escrever códigos de desenvolvimento dos sistemas seguindo padrões de nomenclatura e práticas da empresa; Detalhar projetos, determinando suas interfaces, limites de automação e plataforma tecnológica; Construir modelos funcionais e de dados de sistemas, aplicando boas práticas que garantam visão estruturada, qualidade, reutilização, facilidade de manutenção de códigos; Identificar, avaliar e definir frameworks, componentes e softwares para desenvolvimento, através da conceituação, documentação e experimentação, buscando aprimorar as soluções desenvolvidas; Realizar avaliações de segurança e performance de soluções; Aplicar e avaliar testes funcionais e não funcionais, seguindo o plano de testes estabelecido, junto ao cliente visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente; Escrever o plano de testes funcionais e não funcionais visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente; Avaliar e elaborar a documentação de usuário e administração de sistemas desenvolvidos e os repositórios de informação dos projetos; Assegurar as interfaces de integração com outras plataformas/soluções. Habilidades Técnicas Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de software; Conhecimento com IA; Experiência trabalhando com serviços restfull e microserviços; Conhecimentos em html5, CSS3, node.js, angular, vue e react; Conhecimentos em Python; Conhecimentos em SQL e Análise de Dados; Experiência em levantar e documentar requisitos juntos aos usuários; Capacidade de realizar testes unitários e de integração; Capacidade de desenvolvimento de soluções utilizando todas as linguagens suportadas na plataforma ArcGIS. Habilidades Desejáveis: Vivência em metodologias ágeis; Conhecimentos na plataforma ArcGIS; Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios.

review_candidates.title: Application Developer
review_candidates.description: A2 Global is a global distributor of electronic components, headquartered in the Tampa Bay area with operations across North America, Europe, and Asia. Our internal application development team builds and supports the systems that run the business. We are looking for an enthusiastic and talented Application Developer to join our team. This position is remote but may initially require some work onsite as part of the training program. ABOUT THE ROLE: Alva and Fasttrack are our proprietary ERP applications — designed, built, and maintained entirely in-house by our own development team. They are not off-the-shelf products we configure; every feature is written and owned by us. Alva runs on ASP.NET MVC (.NET Framework, C#) over SQL Server, and Fasttrack runs on PHP using the CodeIgniter framework. Both are on active development roadmaps, and both read from and write to the same shared SQL Server database. We are adding a developer to own application logic and data work across the stack — someone who is comfortable moving between the two applications and who treats the shared database as a first-class part of the job. WHAT YOU'LL DO: Build, enhance, and maintain server-side application logic for both Alva (.NET / C#) and Fasttrack (PHP). Work directly in a shared SQL Server database: write and troubleshoot complex queries and stored procedures, and reason carefully about schema changes that affect both applications. Design, build, and consume Web API / REST services connecting the two applications and external systems. Translate business requirements into working, maintainable code — from requirements gathering through development, testing, and documentation. Identify, diagnose, and correct defects across both codebases. Contribute to data-conversion and system-integration work. Participate in code review and follow shared coding standards. Participate in on-call and daily support activities. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR: Application-first engineering: strong object-oriented development, with primary depth in either C# / .NET or PHP and a demonstrated ability — and willingness — to work in the other. SQL Server depth: complex queries, stored procedures, and relational data modeling; comfortable owning changes to a schema shared by more than one application. MVC architecture: practical experience building applications on an MVC pattern. Web services: designing and integrating Web API / REST services. Version control: comfortable with Git-based workflows and sound branch / merge practices. Full lifecycle: requirements, design, build, test, document, and support. Experience: 5+ years building and maintaining business applications preferred （2+ minimum）. Education: Bachelors in CIS, MIS, Computer Science, or equivalent experience. THIS IS A SERVER-SIDE ENGINEERING ROLE: This position is focused on application logic, data, and integration — not front-end visual design. Working knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS is useful for supporting the applications' existing interfaces, but this is not a UI / UX design position. We are looking for an engineer who is at home in business logic, coding, and the database. WHY A2 GLOBAL: You will join a small, high-impact team where your work directly affects how the business runs. We offer a comprehensive package including medical, dental, vision coverage, Disability, life insurance, vacation / personal days, and a 401k with company match, in a business-casual environment.
